crossRefs.note: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men.
They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

translations.web: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.
translations.kjv: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
translations.asv: Fill their faces with confusion, That they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.
